ground_truth.title: Home - Ohio Artisan Collective
ground_truth.main_content:
Support Small, Buy Artisan

Shopping an Artisan brand supports small businesses and their families. When you buy from Ohio Artisan Collective you are supporting over 95 small businesses and their dreams.

Shop Local

Buying local keeps inspiration alive in the next generation and local community.

Corporate Gifting

Thank your clients by giving them a handmade personal Artisan product. These carefully crafted pieces will symbolize the care and dedication you have to them.

Personal Gifting

When finding the perfect gift seems impossible, Ohio Artisan Collective makes it possible. Our perfectly curated gifts provide a sense of home to that special someone.

See what people are saying about us!

"Welcoming and knowledgeable staff, awesome collection of artists from around the area, bought a few things a few weeks ago from this shop. Great quality stuff!! Definitely will be returning!"

TARA

"Thanks for all the great signs and other gifts we got this year from your aurora farms store.  Everyone felt extra special with handmade and handpicked gifts from you and other vendors."

JENNY

“Love supporting local Artisans. My favorite “gift” store in town for years!”

PATRICIA
